positioning: Little souls. Big feelings. Built on Base.

generation.art_note: AI cinematic interpretations of original SOULI characters. Not pixel-identical SVG reproductions and not game recordings.
generation.review: All delivered MP4 files decoded completely; six-frame sheets inspected for hero, ETH-up and ETH-down. Promotional clips are not certified seamless loops.

sources_to_check_at_publication.base_news: Follow the specific primary announcement linked from official Base channels and check its publication date. Do not reuse an old event as current news.

selection_rules: No publishing or scheduling while the owner's preparation-only instruction is in effect.
SOULI user-impacting incidents take precedence over all promotional posts. Check both official network status and actual SOULI impact.
Next priority: verified SOULI product news, then relevant Base community news, then ETH mood, then evergreen GM.

Check ETH direction, data timestamp and observation period immediately before using a market-direction caption. Reuse the game's 15-minute maximum data age as a conservative operational rule; stale or missing data means no direction claim.
ETH direction and Base news are independent signals. Never infer a partnership, endorsement or price effect from a Base announcement.
Use the down-market animation for ordinary market emotion; never use it to joke about an exploit, outage or real losses.
A SOULI-relevant outage pauses celebratory and purchase CTA posts. State observed impact, timestamp, source and next action; do not promise an unverified recovery time.
Record a recovery only after official status and relevant SOULI functions have both been checked.
Keep news/date/price text out of reusable video pixels. Add timely information in the post caption only after verification.
Use real gameplay footage for product claims. Generated clips are promotional animation. Mark local development footage WIP.
Use one simple next action where useful. Do not add a buy CTA to every mood post.
No fixed price promises, fake users, fake affiliations, invented milestones or duplicate mass replies.

cadence_proposal.exception: Necessary service notices are separate from promotional cadence.
cadence_proposal.rule: Relevant verified events replace a planned slot. These are recommendations, not a registered schedule.

assets.implementation_notes: Muted autoplay with playsinline, loop and a poster. Respect reduced motion and retain readable text/CTA outside faces. Avoid aggressive mobile crops. Test the actual page before release.
